title: pepinia nuda
intro: Pepinia nuda, commonly known as Naked Passionflower, is a plant species belonging to the Passifloraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relieving anxiety, insomnia, and other sleep disorders due to its calming effects. The health benefits of Pepinia nuda are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as sedation, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Pepinia nuda include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
